title: Lift the herdr transport client into ticfac, unchanged
description:
Move the herdr TRANSPORT into ticfac, unchanged. Behaviour-preserving lift, so
every later tick hardens code that already lives here.

What moves, from ticks `internal/herd/`:
- `client/` (14 files, ~4394 lines) — the typed unix-socket JSON client. Its
  types are pure herdr wire shapes (types.go); no tracker type crosses that
  boundary, which is why it lifts cleanly. `events.go` (626 lines) is the reason
  the package exists: the herdr CLI has no `events.subscribe`.
- `herdtest/` (~1513 lines) — the one canonical fake herdr server.
- `gitcmd/` (36 lines) — the shared git shell-out, if ticfac has no equivalent;
  prefer ticfac's existing git helper and drop this.

What does NOT move: `state/` (its `Manifest` mixes herdr identity with tracker
identity, and ticfac already has JobHandle + run-state for both halves).

Rules:
- No behaviour change. This tick is a move plus package renames plus whatever
  the compiler demands. Hardening is w2's job — resist fixing what you find, and
  write it down instead.
- ticks keeps working. Until the retire tick, ticks may vendor or import nothing
  from ticfac; leave its copy in place and note the duplication. Do NOT delete
  from ticks here.
- Record anything you notice that later ticks should fix, in your RESULT file.

Note for the record: the fake advertises protocol 20 / herdr 0.8.2
(`herdtest/replies.go:13,41`) but its recorded shapes are herdr 0.8.0 /
protocol 19 (`client/testdata/event_stream.ndjson:1`), and
`session_snapshot.json` was hand-edited to claim 20 over a 0.8.0 body. Do not
fix that here; the drift tick owns it.
